title: Northstar realignment kit and all-staff rehearsal notes
body:
Purpose and scope:
- One-pager kit for an operationally tight all‑staff + exec update that realigns teams to a narrowed north star for the next 12 weeks.
- This doc is a working rehearsal script, OKR draft capture, and comms checklist; not the final slide deck.

High-level objective (single sentence):
- Reset the company around a single delivery lens: predictable inference economics for production workloads (latency, cost/unit, reliability) and the operational levers teams can use to meet that lens.

Desired outcomes for the event (measurable):
- 90% of teams have at least one clarified next‑quarter OKR linked to the north star within 48 hours.
- Execs approve the proposed escalation policy and two cross‑team dependencies by EOD+3.
- All‑staff NPS pulse (quick poll) > +25 for clarity-of-priorities.

Audience and timing: 
- Audience: All employees, with breakout moments for Eng, Product, SRE, and CS.
- Duration: 75 minutes + 15-minute optional region-specific syncs.
- Date candidate: Week of 2025-03-10 (confirm with exec calendar).

Run of show (rehearsal script with owner notes):
1) 00:00–05:00 Welcome + framing (CEO) — Maya to cue CEO. Slide: single metric visual (latency vs cost last 6 months).
   - Note: CEO opens with one concrete example of customer impact from last quarter.
2) 05:00–15:00 The north star story (Head of Product) — Priya. Slide: one page narrative + 3 supporting signals.
   - Rehearsal cue: use the example of a PLG customer lowering P50 by 40% after caching change.
3) 15:00–30:00 Operational levers demo (Eng lead serving-runtime) — Diego. Live-ish demo: batcher/kv-cache trace.
   - Fallback: if live demo flaky, run recorded trace video (prepare 30s clip).
4) 30:00–40:00 Focused OKR framework (People Ops / Product Ops) — Maya. Slide: OKR template + timelines.
   - Call-to-action: each manager to propose 1 team OKR in the next 48 hours.
5) 40:00–55:00 Cross-team dependencies & commitments (Panel: SRE, Infra, Sales Ops) — Owen.
   - Decision ask: approve two cross-team commitments (dedicated quota roadmap + private deploy runbook).
6) 55:00–65:00 Customer spotlight + Q&A (Customer Success) — Leila.
7) 65:00–75:00 Closing, next steps, and pulse (CEO + Maya) — pulse link live.

Breakouts (post‑all‑hands, optional):
- Eng / SRE: 30 minutes on rollout safety and SLA tradeoffs. Owner: Diego.
- Product: 30 minutes on measurement plan for OKRs. Owner: Priya.
- CS / GTM: 30 minutes on customer comms and pilot invites. Owner: Leila.

OKR draft capture (working list to be refined after the event):
- Company Objective: Make inference predictable and 3x more cost‑efficient for typical PLG workloads by end of Q3.
  - KR1: 20% reduction in median per‑token cost for top 10 customer flows.
  - KR2: Latency P95 < 400ms on hosted tier for 90% of requests.
  - KR3: 99.95% availability for Dedicated clusters across regions.

- Product Objective: Ship Model Variant Routing and automatic fallback in serving runtime.
  - KR1: Canary rollout mechanism implemented and used in 2 product routes.
  - KR2: Fallback latency win: decreased fallback-triggered SLO violations by 50%.

- Engineering Objective: Improve runtime efficiency and safe rollout primitives.
  - KR1: Prefix/KV cache hit rate > 30% for conversational workloads on average.
  - KR2: Batching improvements reduce GPU token/sec cost by 15%.

Open questions / unresolved issues to surface in the meeting:
- Do we commit to a single canonical north‑star metric (composite of cost + latency + reliability), or let each org pick a primary plus a common composite?
- How do we package Dedicated capacity commitments for early enterprise renewals without breaking self‑serve economics?
- Is the proposed escalation policy (SLO breaches -> auto‑escalate to oncall + product lead) acceptable to SRE?

Risks and mitigation (short):
- Risk: Live demo failure undermines perceived maturity. Mitigation: default to recorded clip; have Diego + infra on call.
- Risk: Exec disagreements publicly aired. Mitigation: pre‑align execs in a 30‑minute prebrief the day before.

Communications and follow-ups: 
- Pre-event: short pre-reads (one page) sent 72h prior, include OKR template and sample team entries. Owner: Maya.
- Immediate follow-up: one consolidated doc with manager submissions due +48h. Owner: Product Ops.
- 1-week: leadership decisions log published (who signed what). Owner: COO EA.

Assets checklist (to finalize before rehearsal):
- One‑pager TL;DR (1 page) — Maya.
- Slide deck draft (10 slides) — Priya.
- Recorded demo clip (30s) + backup screenshots — Diego.
- Pulse link and micro‑survey (3 question) — People Ops.
- Slack announcement + follow-up thread templates — Growth comms.

Prebrief schedule (mandatory for exec presenters):
- Exec prebrief: 30 minutes, scheduled 24h before the event. Agenda: sync on slides, callouts, and hot questions.
- Tech run: 20 minutes, 60 minutes before event start (test share, video, audio).

Metrics snapshot to show in slide 1 (data owner and one‑line interpretation):
- Monthly host API tokens (owner: Finance) — recent trend: +12% m/m with cost per token rising 6%
- P95 latency hosted (owner: SRE) — stable but spiky during batch windows
- Dedicated cluster utilization (owner: Infra) — 68% average, regional imbalance noted

Decision points for execs (we will capture live yes/no):
- Approve the company north‑star composite metric format?
- Authorize two cross‑team commitments (quota model + private deploy runbook) to ship in Q2?

Notes-to-self / working reminders (informal):
- Keep language non-technical in first 10 minutes; the demo should be a single takeaway.
- Call for managers to pre-fill OKR template before the all‑hands to speed up post-event capture.
- Have a named owner for each 'ask' (avoid laundry list).

Next steps (post patched rehearsal):
- Final slide deck v1.0 by 2025-03-03 EOD.
- Exec prebrief calendar invites sent by 2025-03-04.
- Manager OKR intake form live immediately after the all‑staff (deadline +48h).

Appendix: Quick rehearsal checklist (tick box style to use during tech run):
- [ ] Slides loaded and presenter notes visible to speakers.
- [ ] Demo video plays at 1080p without audio glitch.
- [ ] Region-specific sync dial-ins tested for APAC.
- [ ] Pulse link resolves and accepts anonymous responses.
- [ ] Recording consent message ready and shown at start.

End of working draft.

Unresolved: need final owner confirmations and a single canonical date.

Comments: leave inline comments in this doc or ping in slack #all-hands-ops.
